test: named Allis A1-A9 solution predicates versus generic 625-ID blocker upward closure
interpretation: For every generated rule instance, rule-specific solved opponent requirements were exactly reproduced by OR-ing precomputed upward closures of the rule's certified blocker set(s).
This tests the coverage representation, not full strategic-rule soundness or compatibility selection.
A4/A8/A9 were represented from their formal solution shapes as tail/successor blocker sets plus component blockers; their response-policy validity remains a U1 question.
The result strongly supports using the existing 625-ID subset lattice as the universal strategic coverage owner rather than retaining nine rule-specific solved-group representations.
